title: reversal-recruit as a build-set shape
body: The pure fix for the cutoffs decoy pool being produced rather than built. Blocked on build-set having to run searches before it could place, which the cross work does not change. A sampling proposal for libsail sits in tmp-claude/libsail-sampling-proposal.md.

notes.author: jackroddy/21204bf1
notes.text: The libsail sampling proposal that sat in tmp-claude was removed with the rest of the scratch on 6 Oct.
